events.text: Make the charge and slam hit like Gang Beasts. A charger crouches behind his shield with a dust kick, and a lane of red rings lies ahead of the run. Everyone the charge hits flies up and back off the line with a full spin, BOWLED! over him, a crack, sparks and dust, and gets up slowly; the charge runs on to the next man. A raised shield facing it stops it dead with a big clang, gold sparks and BRACED!, and the charger bounces back wide open. The slam is a real leap, higher than a man for near a second, weapon cocked, the camera rising too; the red ring throbs as I fall, and the landing shows SLAM!, a dust ring and a shock wave throwing everyone in it out, a big shake. All bots charge and slam often, brace or sidestep a charge, and run out of the ring. Show F and C READY or counting down.

events.text:
- `data/moves.json` `rush.wind` changed from 18 to 22: the crouch is longer, so it reads as a tell of at least 20 frames (tofu `tell_min_f` went from 18 to 21).
- `data/ai.json` `big.rush_p` changed from 0.3 to 0.45 and `big.slam_p` from 0.6 to 0.8, so rivals charge and slam more often ("All bots charge and slam often"). The crew's rates in `data/crew.json` are another package's and are unchanged.
- New `data/tuning.json` block `big_fx` holds every new number: impact word time, size and colours; flight 40 frames, 1.1 m high, 1 full turn; leap 2.2 m; camera lift 0.5 times the leap; ring throb; lane of 5 rings 1.1 m apart; crack, clang and spark sizes; charge-hit shake 0.14.
- The leap and the bowled flight-and-spin are drawing only: they lift and turn the rig node and never move the physics body. Contact logic (who the slam hits, the bowled-over knockdown, the braced bounce) is unchanged.
- `show.leap_y(f)` is a new public function on show.gd, which camera.gd reads to lift the play lens during the captain's slam.
- A charge or slam contact of type `knockdown` or `blocked_heavy` now uses its own sounds, sparks and words in `show.contact` instead of the generic contact effects.
- No new moves this round: the charge (`rush`) and slam were already in the game.
- NOT DONE: making the crew mates charge and slam more often needs `data/crew.json`, which is outside my scope: raise `big.rush_p` from 0.3 to 0.45 and `big.slam_p` from 0.35 to 0.5.

[foreman] part of your change was NOT made by core; it goes on to crew, whose files core names: NOT DONE: making the crew mates charge and slam more often needs `data/crew.json`, which is outside my scope: raise `big.rush_p` from 0.3 to 0.45 and `big.slam_p` from 0.35 to 0.5.

[foreman] the rest of your change, which core did not make ("NOT DONE: making the crew mates charge and slam more often needs `data/crew.json`, which is outside my scope: raise `big.rush_p` from 0.3 to 0.45 and `big.slam_p` from 0.35 to 0.5."): "Make the charge and slam hit like Gang Beasts. A charger crouches behind his shield with a dust kick, and a lane of red rings lies ahead of the run. Everyone the charge hits flies up and back off the line with a full spin, BOWLED! over him, a crack, sparks and dust, and gets up slowly; the charge runs on to the next man. A raised shield facing it stops it dead with a big clang, gold sparks and BRACED!, and the charger bounces back wide open. The slam is a real leap, higher than a man for near a second, weapon cocked, the camera rising too; the red ring throbs as I fall, and the landing shows SLAM!, a dust ring and a shock wave throwing everyone in it out, a big shake. All bots charge and slam often, brace or sidestep a charge, and run out of the ring. Show F and C READY or counting down."

- `data/crew.json` `ai.big`: `rush_p` 0.3 → 0.45, `slam_p` 0.35 → 0.5, `rush_from` 2.6 → 2.2 m (bots fighting a step or two apart now find room to charge), `crowd` 2 → 1 (one foe close enough now draws a slam, not only two or more). New key `sidestep_p` 0.35.
- RULE: when a bot sees a charge aimed at it (3 frames into the crouch, within 25° of its line), it raises its shield with chance defend + 0.3 as before. If it does not brace and is free to move, it now dodges sideways off the charge line with chance 0.35. The player sees bots stop a visible charge most of the time, either BRACED! or by stepping aside.
- I added no new moves; the charge and slam are core's. `tests/bot_crew.gd` does not report `metrics.moves` for `rush` or `slam`, so this run does not prove that the bots' charges and slams land.
- I did not run invariants this round because of the time limit. All new random choices use `ctx.rng`.

NEW MOVE: rush
NEW MOVE: slam
- `tests/bot_crew.gd`: the captain now uses the charge and the slam in normal fighting (not in the lesson or the light-mashing round), which changes this bot's play compared with earlier rounds.
- "Started" counts the wind-ups of all six fighters, not only the captain's.
